chapter.verse: Numei tawh mawhna tham lo a pa’ zi, zi-a a nei Gentailte lak nangawn ah a kiza ngei lo mawhna, note lakah a om thu a kithang zo hi.
Tua banga gamtate note lakah na hawlkhiat nadingun, lungsim dahna na neih loh uh tham loin, na kisathei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka pum in note tawh a kigamlat hangin ka kha in note tawh a omkhawm mah bangin, tua bang a gamta mi tungah thu ka khen zo hi.
Ka thukhenna in i Topa Zeisu’ min tawh note in keima kha tawh na kikhop uh ciangin, i Topa Zeisu’ vangliatna suangin,
Topa Zeisu’ Ni ciangin tua mipa’ kha in gupna a ngah theih nadingin ama pumpi a kisiat na’ng Satan’ khut sungah na pia ta un ci-in ka khen hi.
Na kisaktheihna uh a hoih kei hi. Silngo tawmkha in annel sial lom khat a tawksak ding thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Note in silngo tawh na kipelh mah bangun annel sial thak na suah theih nadingun silngo lui na mangsak khin un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Khazih ahi eite Paisan’ Tuuno a kigo zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin silngo lui tawh, hai leh gilo silngote tawh hi loin silngo om lo siangtho leh thuman anlum tawh pawikham ni.
Numei tawh a mawhte tawh na kikholh loh nadingun tu ma-in lai sungah ka gelh zo hi.

Tua bang ka gelhna in hih leitung numei tawh mawhte, huaiham-a duhhopte, zawhthawh bawla a sutte leh milim a biate tawh kikhawl peuhmah kei un ka cihnopna ahi kei hi. Tua bang ci leng leitung pan na paikhia ding uh hi!

Unau kici numei tawh a mawhte, huaiham-a duhhopte, milim a biate, hangsana kosiate, zukhamte, zawhthawh bawl-a a sutte, tua bang a hihte tawh kikhawl lo tham loin an nangawn na nekhawm kei un, ci-in ka gelh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a pualam mite thukhenna tawh bang kikum ka hi hiam? A sung lamah a om note in thukhen hilo na hi uh hiam?
A pua lamah a omte Pasian in thu a khen ding hi. Tua a gilopa note lak pan na hawlkhia un.
